title: Quest, Objective, Mission, Task & Milestone Authoring
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Quest, Objective, Mission, Task and Milestone authoring over the MAS-01..04 foundations, using explicit owner-domain references and proposals without duplicating canonical Quest/runtime state or treating planned progress as live completion.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Quest, Objective, Mission, Task and Milestone authoring inside the MAS workspace while preserving canonical Quest/runtime ownership and prepared-versus-live progress boundaries.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author Quest, Objective, Mission, Task and Milestone definitions through explicit references/proposals over MAS-01..04 foundations while preserving canonical Quest/runtime state authority and never treating planned or reachable progress as completed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 workspace/document authority, MAS-02 higher-order structure, MAS-03 prepared assembly and MAS-04 prepared nonlinear graph remain foundational and were not reopened.

Quest, Objective, Mission, Task and Milestone definitions are prepared MAS authoring semantics only; canonical Quest and runtime owner domains retain state, completion, failure, reward and mutation authority.
CNI remains progression/runtime authority; MAS-05 does not evaluate CNI quest-state triggers or execute progression callbacks.
Planned, reachable or authored progress never proves live completion, failure or reward state.
MAS-05 consumes an explicit validated Quest owner binding and optional MAS-04 route references; unresolved references fail closed.
Prepared progress keeps completed objectives/tasks, reached milestones, failed quest plans and granted rewards explicitly empty.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-05.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-05, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-06 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-07+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-05 is closed. MAS-06 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
